d: A controversy has erupted over claims that China has occupied parts of Arunachal Pradesh, after Congress leader Ritu Choudhary shared a video alleging Chinese incursions into Indian territory. The post also claimed that despite repeated requests, the Indian Army was not receiving essential supplies and that security forces were being deployed against protesters instead of China. However, the Indian Army has reportedly dismissed the video shared by Congress as fake.
